title: Lie Groups
author: Daniel Bump
context: Daniel Bump, Lie Groups, Springer, Berlin, 2004. (A friendly tour of the vast and fascinating panorama of mathematics surrounding groups, starting from really basic stuff and working on up to advanced topics.
